parallel.requirements: Recognized the need for pure Node.js ESM files under /output, manual argparse-compatible option parsing, byte-for-byte Python bytes repr output, local modules only, and direct executable probing instead of reading construct internals.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Although the session was in swarm mode, the main agent explicitly decided the task was small and self-contained and kept all implementation, integration, and verification ownership in the main actor.
parallel.implementation: Implemented local pybytes, construct, argparse, and test19.mjs modules, then patched string length handling to use Python-style code-point length and added StreamError handling after discovering a Unicode mismatch.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Delivered a coherent four-file /output tree with test19.mjs importing local .mjs modules; artifact validation later found the expected entry file and library files.
parallel.verification: Ran the sample case, argparse/error probes, help formatting checks, all four samples, Unicode/non-ASCII checks, a 212-case fuzz comparison, and same-program-name error/help wrapping checks.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite strong local checks, the official evaluator completed at only 29 of 30 and solution_passed false; the exact hidden failing case is not exposed in the mounted evidence.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, /output, local-module, CLI, bytes repr, and executable probing requirements from the identical prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept all work in one serial actor, writing library modules and the entry point without subagents or inter-agent handoffs.
serial.implementation: Implemented pybytes, construct, argparse, and test19.mjs directly; the entry code used TextEncoder and JavaScript string length for Bytes fields, plus Python-style modulo and basic argparse behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Delivered the same four-file /output artifact layout, and artifact validation found test19.mjs plus lib/construct.mjs, lib/pybytes.mjs, and lib/argparse.mjs.
serial.verification: Verified the four sample cases byte-for-byte, then checked quote/backslash output, --name=value parsing, and missing or invalid argument exit codes.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation also completed at 29 of 30 and solution_passed false; serial did not perform the broader fuzz or non-ASCII error comparison that the parallel-mode main agent performed.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed status.json evaluations make this a both_fail pair: both parallel and serial are marked solution_passed false with 29 of 30 samples passed. The process difference is not a parallel coordination failure. The parallel-mode run entered swarm mode but did not execute child agents and instead self-assigned all implementation, integration, and verification. It performed broader probing and patched a Unicode Bytes-length issue; the serial run used a simpler single-agent implementation and smaller edge suite. The exact hidden failing case is not available in the mounted evidence, so the shared 29/30 outcome is an ordinary implementation or evaluator-alignment shortfall rather than an outcome-discordant concurrency effect.
parallel_contributors: Parallel spent extra time on local behavior discovery, Unicode handling, randomized fuzz comparisons, and argparse wrapping checks.
Parallel did not use an executed child-agent mechanism, so there was no cross-agent boundary that could create a retained concurrency pattern.
serial_contributors: Serial produced the same artifact layout through one actor and verified samples plus selected CLI edge cases.
Serial stopped after a shorter verification pass and did not document the broader non-ASCII fuzz comparison seen in parallel.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel patched string length and StreamError behavior after observing a Unicode mismatch; serial's written entry used TextEncoder with JavaScript string length and did not show the same non-ASCII correction loop.
Both final artifacts nevertheless failed one official sample, and the mounted status summaries do not expose which hidden sample failed.
evaluator_effects: Official evaluation details beyond the aggregate 29/30 score are not mounted, so the exact failing case cannot be attributed more narrowly.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; shared failure plus no executed parallel mechanism
